# Unbrewed

> Unbrewed is a free, open-source, browser-based way to play Unmatched board game
> fan decks online. There are four tables: a free-form 2D Sandbox where any deck
> and any image map work and the players apply the rules; Unbrewed Pro, where a
> referee server enforces the full rules and you can fight bots or people; a 3D
> table, where our lobby spawns a table.place table (also ours) for both decks and
> a map; and IRL mode, which turns a phone into the deck tray at a real board.
> No install and no account needed; signing in with Discord is optional. It is an
> unofficial hobby project and is not affiliated with Restoration Games, the
> publisher of Unmatched.

## Ways to play
- [Sandbox](https://unbrewed.xyz/connect): a shared 2D table with hand, dice, tokens and any image as a map. Name a lobby and send the invite link; nothing is enforced, so any fan deck works on day one.
- [Unbrewed Pro](https://unbrewed.xyz/pro): rules-enforced matches. Only legal moves, combat math done for you, hidden hands. Bots from Easy through Medium, Hard and Expert to Prodigy (unlocked by beating Expert); duel, three-player free-for-all and 2v2; an optional move timer; Quick Match; replays of every finished game; a flat board or a 3D tabletop view with minis. Its roster is hand-converted fan decks and grows a few heroes at a time.
- [3D table](https://unbrewed.xyz/table): our lobby that spawns a 3D table at table.place. Pick both decks and a map, send your friend their seat link, then deal, drag, flip and stack; minis for the heroes that have them.
- [IRL mode](https://unbrewed.xyz/irl): your phone is the deck tray (hand, deck, discard, health) while the board and the opponent are real. Installable and works offline.

## Compete and progress
- [Tournaments](https://unbrewed.xyz/tournaments): async Pro tournaments — single elimination or round robin — shared by one link; players ready up on their own time and results and replays land on the bracket. Creating one needs a Discord sign-in.
- [Leaderboard](https://unbrewed.xyz/leaderboard): community standings for Pro games.
- [Heroes](https://unbrewed.xyz/heroes): every Pro hero with its ladder.
- [Stats](https://unbrewed.xyz/stats): public player profiles.
- [Collection](https://unbrewed.xyz/collection): signed-in players earn XP, badges and cosmetic points from Pro games and spend points on card and token rims (bronze to iridescent). Cosmetics never change a card, a rule or a result.

## Decks and maps
- [Deck bag](https://unbrewed.xyz/bag): import decks from unmatched.cards, Unmatched Labs, the-unmatched.club, Tabletop Simulator (TTS) exports, raw JSON, or lists of card image URLs; manage custom maps. Signed-in bags sync across devices.
- Maps: a bundled set of legacy and community boards, or any image URL.

## Project
- [Changelog](https://unbrewed.xyz/changelog): every update, newest first.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/JollyGrin/unbrewed-p2p): MIT-licensed source and issue tracker.
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/qPxHFjwkNN): community, match-making and support.

## Key facts
- Price: free (open-source, MIT-licensed)
- Account: optional (Discord sign-in syncs the bag and records Pro games)
- Runs in: any modern web browser, desktop or phone
